title: HtmlNav
responsibility: Renders the native nav element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlNav.attributes
inputs.description: Native nav attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlNav.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native nav element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlNav
outputs.description: The actual native nav element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
